title: The way in
starting_code: # The door is sealed and also listens for the school's word.
hints: Move up to stand before the door first.
You have to use the `say` method for the password and the `cast` method for the spell.
After doing both things, take one more step to walk into the hall.
intro: This is it, the castle's great door! It is sealed by a rune, and it also listens for the school's word. We have to do everything together to get in!
outro: The door is open! Let us walk into the great hall.
